inlines.v: SUPERB', adjective [Latin superbus, proud, from super.] 1. Grand; magnificent; as a superb edifice; a superb colonnade. 2. Rich; elegant; as superb furniture or decorations. 3. Showy; pompous; as a superb exhibition. 4. Rich; splendid; as a superb entertainment. 5. August; stately.
